hooks.command: ROOT=$(cat | jq -r '.cwd'); ROOT=$(git -C "$ROOT" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1{print $2}'); if [ -n "$ROOT" ] && git -C "$ROOT" status --short | grep -qE '^[ MADRCU?][MADRCU?]|^[MADRCU][MADRCU ]'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Uncommitted changes in the main checkout. Move them into a .claude/worktrees/ branch — main takes no direct commits."}'; else echo '{}'; fi
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts || "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then cd /workspaces/karasu && npx oxfmt --write "$FILE" 2>&1 && npx oxlint "$FILE" 2>&1; fi
